summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the execution of an indenture and a first supplemental indenture dated May 26, 2026, with Computershare Trust Company, N.A. and Computershare Trust Company of Canada as trustees. The indenture governs the terms for future issuances of debt securities in series, including provisions on authentication, events of default, and trustee duties. No specific debt issuance, special event, or transaction terms are disclosed. This is a routine financing documentation filing, not a special situation.
